reports.title: Meter refusal and inflated fixed fare
reports.description: Drivers quoted a high fixed fare without explaining a meter or toll breakdown.
reports.action: Use an official/prepaid counter or agree on meter use and the total before loading luggage.

reports.title: Attraction closed redirection
reports.description: Unsolicited people claimed an attraction or hotel was closed and redirected travellers to a tour shop.
reports.action: Verify directly with the attraction or hotel before changing plans.

reports.title: Unofficial guide pressure
reports.description: Visitors were pressured to accept a guide service before a full price was stated.
reports.action: Ask for credentials and agree on the total price before accepting a service.

reports.title: Unexpected restaurant service charge
reports.description: A large service charge was added to the bill without clear prior disclosure.
reports.action: Request an itemized bill and ask whether service charges were disclosed before ordering.

reports.title: Poor exchange rate / short change
reports.description: Exchange totals and fees were unclear until after cash was handed over.
reports.action: Confirm rate, commission, and total payout before exchanging money.
